# Kohope Medical

> > Shanghai-based wholesale manufacturer and exporter of disposable medical supplies and devices to 50+ countries worldwide.

Kohope Medical is a leading medical device manufacturer specializing in disposable healthcare products. The company serves as a bulk supplier and wholesale provider, maintaining strict quality assurance standards for healthcare solutions across international markets.

## Company Overview

- [Kohope Medical - Wholesale Chinese Medical Supplies Company](https://kohope.com): Shanghai-based medical device manufacturer exporting disposable products to 50+ countries with focus on quality assurance and healthcare solutions.
